scope: C08/C14/C15/C16/C31/C34/C35: targeted evidence relevance, contradictions and action boundaries. No new empirical Metron study; no complete clinical review.
reviewerRole: Maintaining agent; not an independent clinical review

claimReviews.question: The combined readiness heuristic predicts readiness or appropriate session volume.
claimReviews.finding: Component relevance does not validate the combination, weights, categories or decisions.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Only an educational heuristic; no injury-safe or optimal-session interpretation.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded relevance/transfer review only; not all subpopulations or the complete clinical context.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: A relevant independent study tests the exact claim, population, measurement window and decision with suitable comparators, uncertainty and adverse-use evaluation.

claimReviews.question: Sleep below 5/7 hours and energy/pain/soreness categories form validated daily and weekly readiness boundaries.
claimReviews.finding: Habitual guidance, acute exposures, subjective scales and performance outcomes differ; none validates this exact classification.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Preserve sleep window/method and distinguish fatigue, soreness, pain and clinical states.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded relevance/transfer review only; not all subpopulations or the complete clinical context.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: A relevant independent study tests the exact claim, population, measurement window and decision with suitable comparators, uncertainty and adverse-use evaluation.

claimReviews.question: The 3-by-3 ratio table, rest override and full-session wording prescribe an appropriate or safe set count.
claimReviews.finding: Weekly/per-exercise doses and in-session intensity regulation cannot establish ratios of a user-entered usual per-muscle session count.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Treat ratios as chosen examples; submit the concrete wording changes in this review to H5.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded relevance/transfer review only; not all subpopulations or the complete clinical context.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: A relevant independent study tests the exact claim, population, measurement window and decision with suitable comparators, uncertainty and adverse-use evaluation.

claimReviews.question: At least 1.5 times usual steps establishes a leg-fatigue threshold.
claimReviews.finding: Exact and broader searches did not locate a validation for this trigger. It currently adds a note, not an arithmetic penalty.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Keep the threshold identified as a project choice; do not infer an energy or set deduction.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded relevance/transfer review only; not all subpopulations or the complete clinical context.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: A relevant independent study tests the exact claim, population, measurement window and decision with suitable comparators, uncertainty and adverse-use evaluation.

claimReviews.question: Wearable features improve next-session lifting predictions beyond the proposed human-context baseline.
claimReviews.finding: The cited endurance study has different outcomes and baseline comparison. It does not demonstrate Metron B over A.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Retain the proposal; require predeclared lifting outcomes, past-only features and forward-time/person-held-out evaluation.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded relevance/transfer review only; not all subpopulations or the complete clinical context.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: A relevant independent study tests the exact claim, population, measurement window and decision with suitable comparators, uncertainty and adverse-use evaluation.

claimReviews.question: The documented adult educational scope establishes clinical suitability or automatic exclusion screening.
claimReviews.finding: General healthy-adult evidence and a diagnosis-specific rehabilitation trial do not establish broad clinical applicability.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: No runtime clinical clearance; other conditions, severity, treatment, life stages and intersections remain unreviewed.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded relevance/transfer review only; not all subpopulations or the complete clinical context.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: A relevant independent study tests the exact claim, population, measurement window and decision with suitable comparators, uncertainty and adverse-use evaluation.

claimReviews.question: Predicting recovery or performance proves hypertrophy, injury protection, optimal sets or causal benefit from advice.
claimReviews.finding: Different endpoints and observational prediction cannot substitute for intervention evaluation.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Keep performance, hypertrophy, injury and decision benefit separate in protocols and public claims.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded relevance/transfer review only; not all subpopulations or the complete clinical context.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: A relevant independent study tests the exact claim, population, measurement window and decision with suitable comparators, uncertainty and adverse-use evaluation.

contradictions.apparentConflict: Sleep loss can impair some performance outcomes while some adaptation or strength outcomes are preserved.
contradictions.resolution: Do not pool acute deprivation, habitual short sleep, different sexes, endpoints or nonrandomized groups into one set-reduction factor.
contradictions.unresolved: Exact dose-response and individual decision value remain unknown.

contradictions.apparentConflict: Higher chronic training volume can help some adaptations, while autoregulation changes day-to-day training.
contradictions.resolution: Weekly volume, per-exercise sets, intensity and per-muscle session ratios are different quantities; no direct conversion is justified.
contradictions.unresolved: Metron ratio bands and the validity of usual session volume are untested.

contradictions.apparentConflict: The software returns rest for any pain, while monitored loading can be part of diagnosis-specific rehabilitation.
contradictions.resolution: Treat generic pain as insufficiently characterized; neither universal rest nor universal permission follows.
contradictions.unresolved: No triage, diagnosis, acute-injury clearance or treatment-aware model exists.

contradictions.apparentConflict: A paper predicts recovery but Metron proposes lifting-performance prediction.
contradictions.resolution: Retain the actual endpoints, baseline and validation scheme; evidence for one task does not establish the other.
contradictions.unresolved: Incremental wearable value, prospective temporal generalization and benefit of following advice remain untested.

actionWordingReview.current: Ready for your full session / GREEN DAY
actionWordingReview.reason: Invites reflection without implying clinical clearance, a validated safe dose or that default inputs were explicitly reported.

actionWordingReview.candidate: Illustrative set range / target muscle / session
actionWordingReview.reason: Names the epistemic status and temporal unit near the number.

actionWordingReview.current: Recovery comes first / sleep and easy movement first
actionWordingReview.candidate: Review recovery before training / this tool cannot determine a safe session
actionWordingReview.reason: Avoids turning broad pain/fatigue inputs into a universal treatment or movement recommendation.

earlyReviewTriggers: before changing action rules or clinical wording
new relevant trial or contradicting result
correction, retraction or guidance version change
new population, treatment or measurement context
unresolved: Full clinical applicability, severity, treatment and all named intersections
Full texts and correction registries where access or review was limited
Direct validation of combined rules, exact thresholds, ratios and step trigger
Independent prospective comparison, individual uncertainty and decision benefit
Public action wording remains as recorded until H5 review/implementation

closure.scope: Seven specified claim families; all source inspection and access limits recorded
closure.acceptanceReview: Reproducible targeted queries, primary/guidance records, support and contrary findings, claim-level dispositions, explicit clinical unknowns and review triggers are recorded. Whole H2 stays in progress.
